description: List valid values for a WHO GHO dimension such as countries (COUNTRY), WHO regions (REGION), sex categories (SEX), age groups (AGEGROUP), or world bank income groups (WORLDBANKINCOMEGROUP). Essential for discovering valid filter values before querying indicator data. Returns codes and human-readable titles for all values in the dimension. No auth — WHO public reference data, unlimited free.

dimension.description: Dimension code to list values for (e.g. "COUNTRY" for country codes, "REGION" for WHO regions, "SEX" for sex categories, "AGEGROUP" for age groups).

limit.description: Maximum number of values to return (1–100, default 20).

search.description: Filter dimension values by partial title match (e.g. "africa" to filter African countries).

name: who.health.dimension_values

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: WHO GHO — List Dimension Values
